text: the app is good and peculiar compared to the others, but as regards the aspect of habits is a little poor cause you cannot set a frequency that isnt daily and I would say that its the biggest lack. I would gladly keep the subscription but this shortcoming makes it useless if we consider that many habits arent carried out on a daily basis, this offsets all the statistics and interrupts the various streaks. if this possibility is introduced in the next update I will gladly reinstall it!
